expectedResult: No active Bug is created and the abandoned draft does not block later create/edit flows.
actualResult: The unsaved new Bug draft was explicitly discarded. The List Report resumed normally; searching the exact controlled title showed only other existing IDTS-111 records and no row with the discarded title.

List search after discard; exact controlled title has no row.

privacyReview.notes: Controlled UAT title and existing sanitized Bug list only.

limitations: The List Report search tokenized the IDTS terms and returned two other IDTS-111 rows; the exact discarded title was absent from all returned rows.
